setupEn: {{pat}} only ever went up to the executive floor to drop off documents. Then {{docFull}}, the secretary, informs him: "From today, managing your condition is part of my job."
story: 睡眠、体温、食事、脈拍。断る欄のない書類が、毎日一枚ずつ増えていく。
他部署から引き離され、専属になり、資料室の扉には内側から鍵がかかるようになる。
「これも業務ですので」「記録を取らせてください」――事務的な言い方のまま、要求だけが上がっていく。
30日目。本日の項目は、ひとつだけ。
storyEn: Sleep, temperature, meals, pulse. Every day one more form appears, and none of them has a box for refusing.
She pulls him away from the other departments, makes him her exclusive charge, and the archive room door starts locking from the inside.
"This is part of the job." "Please let me record it." The wording stays clerical; only the demands go up.
Day 30: there is just one item on today's list.
appeal: 事務口調のまま追い詰めてくる美人秘書が、30日かけて少しずつ距離を詰めてくる過程を日付入りのセリフで楽しめます
